pipeline_steps.description: Ensure single-channel luminance representation. If input has alpha or multiple channels, convert using standard ITU-R 601-2 luma weights.
Convert uint8 [0, 255] pixel array to float32 scaled to [0.0, 1.0].
Scale shorter edge to 224 preserving thoracic aspect ratio, then center-crop to 224x224.
Replicate single-channel grayscale across 3 channels (1 -> 3) to match ImageNet-compatible 2D convolutional filters.
Standard z-score normalization using canonical ImageNet population statistics.

clahe_policy.rationale: Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization shifts global pixel intensity distributions away from standard ImageNet transfer-learning statistics and amplifies sensor noise. Baseline strictly excludes CLAHE.

mathematical_identity: Training transform and inference serving transform must be 100% mathematically identical.
